items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: Well, Harvey Brooks was a dear friend. He was a wonderful man, a wonderful friend and a very talented man with many, many wonderful tunes to his credit.

ctx.x: I'm on the Board at Local 47, and I considered that a -- when they asked me to -- I started as a trial board member, when there was an opening there. Harvey Brooks, who was a very wonderful guy. Harvey -- did you know Harvey?
